dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Moderate, symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing initiating from the mid-dorsal region and progressing to a sharp, high-contrast taper at the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Slight asymmetrical indentation visible on the left lateral margin mid-body, contrasting with a more uniform convex curvature on the right margin.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Predominantly mature white skin tone across the majority of the dorsal plane, with lower reflectance (grey) concentrated in the anterior third.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Broad, low-frequency transverse band of light-grey pigmentation encircling the neck region posterior to the blowhole.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the pigmented grey neck band and the depigmented white posterior canvas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single high-contrast circular aperture representing the blowhole; no other distinct lesions or rake marks are visible at this resolution.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Linear longitudinal depression extending along the central dorsal axis from the mid-back toward the peduncle, casting a subtle central shadow.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent transverse 'collar' of grey pigmentation localized strictly to the cervical region.
